prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

LEFT: ONE real adult Filipino man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, smooth warm tan skin, a playful half-grin, soft pastel-pink hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a lead hammer head, a gold cube-shaped block, a tin teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single rose-gold ring. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.

Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
